reason: An interactive terminal front end for DeepSeek Harness agents, centered on agent conversations, tool interactions, approvals, session management, and shell-based workflows.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体提供支持流式输出、工具交互、审批和会话管理的交互式终端界面。
summaries.en: An interactive terminal interface for DeepSeek Harness agents with streaming output, tool interactions, approvals, and persistent session management.

capabilities: Provides an interactive terminal user interface for DeepSeek Harness agents
Streams Markdown responses and displays thinking and tool-call output
Creates, resumes, forks, searches, exports, and renames persistent sessions
Supports agent presets, planning mode, background jobs, and subagent session trees
Requests permission approvals and presents interactive user-question forms
Allows direct shell command execution through the terminal interface
Renders image results inline in supported terminals
